test_navigate_to_rules.title: Verify navigating to Admin > General > Rules loads the rules list

steps.action: Open Admin and click Rules in the sidebar.
steps.expected: Rules is painted as the selected tab and the list's search field is empty with the placeholder "Search by Name, Rule Type, Site".

test_add_new_rule_wizard_opens.title: Verify clicking Add New Rule opens the wizard with rule type options

steps.action: Open Admin > Rules and click Add New Rule.
steps.expected: The Select Rule picker opens, offers Entry-Exit, Heat Map, Intrusion Detection, Line Crossing, Loitering and Occupancy, and its Next button is disabled until a type is picked.

test_select_rule_type.title: Verify selecting a rule type in the wizard enables the next step

steps.action: Open Admin > Rules, click Add New Rule and read the Next button.
steps.expected: Next is disabled with no type picked.

steps.action: Click the rule type's card.
steps.expected: Next is enabled.

test_search_rule.title: Verify searching for a rule by name filters the results

steps.action: Open Admin > Rules and type Automation into the search field.
steps.expected: The search field holds the typed text and the list filters to matching rules.

test_edit_rule_notification.title: The rule's Edit icon opens a read-only details drawer with no notification edit

steps.action: Open Admin > Rules, create a rule for this test and click its Edit icon.
steps.expected: A details drawer opens with the rule's devices, schedules and dates, and delete, mute and close icons.

steps.action: Look for a Notification tab or an Update & Close button in the drawer.
steps.expected: Neither is offered and the test skips naming that. If either shows, the test fails so the notification edit flow gets rebuilt.

test_delete_rule.title: Verify deleting the last rule with confirmation dialog.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Rules - Delete
steps.expected: Rules - Delete page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the Delete rule confirmation dialog to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: Delete rule confirmation dialog is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target Delete rule confirmation dialog
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the Delete rule confirmation dialog

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the Delete rule confirmation dialog no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: Delete rule confirmation dialog is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted Delete rule confirmation dialog does not reappear after refresh
